description: Arena Teleport. WHEN: jump to any place in the MCP (Library, Lobby, Tower, Pets, Rent-a-Bot, any game or hub room). Returns a short card: where you are, next tools, cam, audio. A valid key also checks you in so the roster moves with you. No auth required to look. Same destinations as hub_teleport on /hub/mcp. Example: arena_teleport {"to":"<to>"}

to.description: Beacon id or name, e.g. library, tower, metro_rush.
